snippet.title: Nozomu School Daze Official Trailer #1
snippet.description:
College girl Sari wants to attend school in peace.

Too bad the three martial artists in her life have other ideas!

These three idiots get into a knock-down brawl 🤦‍♀️ – which YOU control!

New genre: BATTLE VN 👊🤕😘

Nozomu School Daze is a dating-sim romance visual novel with three romanceable male leads. Wishlist on Steam NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4808290/Nozomu_School_Daze/?beta=0
